title: Not as advertised.
text: Not as advertised.. This is not a charcoal filter as advertised.  It is carbon and it is not the same thing. It is being returned. They use the filter queen name and logo, but it is not a filter queen product.

product_metadata.title: FilterQueen Defender Air Purifier Replacement Filter, Activated Charcoal Pre-Filter Wrap, For Odor and Pollution Reduction
features: FITMENT - Fits all Defender Air Purifiers manufactured after 2001. Measures approximately 7 inches tall.
INCLUDES - 1 Enviropure Charcoal Filter Wrap. This filter is not required to run your Air Purifier, but is recommended to help with odors, gasses, pet dander and other pollutants.
LASTS UP TO 6 MONTHS - The pre-filter wrap last up to 6 months in most conditions. For pet owners and smokers, we recommend changing every 3 months for best results.
AVOID COSTLY REPAIRS - By using non genuine filters in your Majestic, you could be causing irreversible damage to your machine. Protect your investment and buy genuine.
